Sally Beauty Company (SBH) Position Lifted by St Germain D J Co Inc
September 7, 2018 - By Kristen Paramore
St Germain D J Co Inc increased its stake in Sally Beauty Company (SBH) by 84.3% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. St Germain D J Co Inc bought 354,535 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.46% with the market. The institutional investor held 775,122 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $12.75M, up from 420,587 at the end of the previous reported quarter. St Germain D J Co Inc who had been investing in Sally Beauty Company for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.93 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.91% or $0.14 during the last trading session, reaching $16.11. About 1.07M shares traded. Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:SBH) has declined 11.28% since September 7, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.85% the S&P500.
St Germain D J Co Inc, which manages about $1.01 billion and $792.13M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Fluor Corp New (NYSE:FLR) by 103,933 shares to 102,408 shares, valued at $5.86 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 20,019 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 199,652 shares, and cut its stake in Goldman Sachs (NYSE:GS).
